title: 1 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Thessalonians 5: the day of the Lord coming like a thief, children of light, and the short commands that close the letter.

questions.text: How does the day of the Lord come, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

answers.text: Like a king with his army
Like a thief in the night

questions.text: What will come on those who are saying “Peace and safety”?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman, and they will in no way escape.

questions.text: What does verse 5 call all of them?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they are all children of light and children of the day, and do not belong to the night or to darkness.

answers.text: Children of light and of the day

questions.text: Instead of sleeping as the rest do, what are they to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: let's not sleep, as the rest do, but let's watch and be sober.

questions.text: What is to be their helmet, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says they are to put on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

questions.text: To what did God appoint them, rather than to wrath?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says God didn't appoint them to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

answers.text: To the keeping of the law

questions.text: What does verse 14 say to do with the faint-hearted?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

questions.text: What are they to see that no one returns to anyone?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says to see that no one returns evil for evil, but always to follow after what is good for one another and for all.

questions.text: What does verse 21 say to do with all things?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says: test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

answers.text: Test them and hold what is good

questions.text: What did the writer solemnly command by the Lord in verse 27?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says he solemnly commands by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

answers.text: That they greet no one outside
That the letter be read to all the brothers
That they send the letter to Athens
That they write back at once
